subject: Eval sprint kickoff plan, timeline, and owners — LuxPay
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@luxpay.com>, Marcus Leong <m.leong@luxpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Eval sprint kickoff plan, timeline, and owners — LuxPay

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can get the eval moving with clear success criteria and owners: 

1) Proposed success criteria (what LuxPay can validate by end of sprint):
   - 95% intent extraction accuracy on your payments routing test set (10k messages)
   - Average 95th-percentile latency under 250ms for 512-token requests under 1x baseline traffic
   - No PII leakage in outputs (pass on the provided PII prompt set)

2) Evaluation plan / timeline (6-week sprint):
   - Week 0 (prep): account access & data handoff, baseline run (API keys + sample dataset)
   - Week 1–3 (integration & tuning): integration, metric collection, one quantized model pass
   - Week 4 (stress & edge cases): throughput test and latency SLO tuning
   - Week 5 (readout prep): consolidate metrics and customer-facing readout
   - Week 6 (final readout): 60-minute results review and next-step recommendations

3) Proposed kickoff weeks (choose one): week of May 10 or week of May 17. Kickoff is 60 minutes and we suggest recurring 30-minute weekly check-ins.

4) Ownership (initial):
   - Redwood owner / AE: Aditya Rao (coordination, agenda, readout)
   - Redwood SE: Karthik Iyer (integration & performance tuning)
   - Customer owner: Elena Rossi (product acceptance, datasets)
   - Customer infra: Marcus Leong (network, test environment)

5) Action items for next 3 business days:
   - Elena: confirm kickoff week and a day/time window (May 10 or May 17)
   - Marcus: confirm whether you can provide a 10k test set and the service account by May 3
   - Aditya: send final agenda & attach scope workbook

Attachments: luxpay-eval-scope.xlsx (xlsx) — a short workbook for success criteria and data inventory.

If this looks good I’ll lock in the kickoff and send the calendar invite + agenda.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval sprint kickoff plan, timeline, and owners — LuxPay

Aditya / team —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple of quick internal questions before we confirm dates with LuxPay: 

- Data access: do we need S3 or can they drop a secured CSV to our upload portal? If S3, we’ll need an IAM role and a pre-signed list of prefixes.
- Network egress: Marcus mentioned a customer-managed VPC option. If they want the private deployment path we’ll need to scope the firewall/peering window — suggest that be a separate conversation.
- Test harness: we should include a simple scoring harness for their 10k test set so they can re-run locally. I can own that if Monica can validate the metrics dashboard fields.

Monica — can you confirm you can take the dashboard ownership? I’ll draft the minimal scoring harness (python) and the config for batch vs streaming mode.

Lauren — looping you for visibility in case there are constraints on AE-owned credits for this trial.

Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@luxpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Leong <m.leong@luxpay.com>, LuxPay - Product Team <product@luxpay.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval sprint kickoff plan, timeline, and owners — LuxPay

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the concise plan — this maps well to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side and confirmations: 

- Success criteria: we agree to the intent-extraction and latency targets. We’d like an additional business metric: reduce manual routing exceptions by 30% on the sample week. We’ll provide labeling for a 2-week window so you can calculate the baseline.
- Data: Marcus will provision an S3 bucket and a read-only IAM role by May 3. We’ll include a representative 10k record set and a 500-record edge-case set (PII tests).
- Security: we’ll need the SOC2 report and a data retention statement prior to PII test runs — please attach or link the standard docs.
- Kickoff: week of May 10 works best for us. Prefer May 11 or May 12 in the morning (ET). 

Owners confirmed: Elena (product), Marcus (infra). We’re fine with weekly 30-minute check-ins and a final 60-minute readout.

Action items for Redwood: final agenda, scoring harness, SOC2 + data retention statement.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Elena Rossi
Head of Product | LuxPay
elena.rossi@luxpay.com | +1 (646) 555-9987

Elena / Marcus —

Appreciate the quick confirm. We’ll lock May 11 at 11:00 AM ET for the kickoff (calendar invite to follow). Summary of what I’ve attached and linked: 

- Attached: redwood-eval-kickoff-agenda.pdf (finalized agenda with objectives & attendee roles)
- Attached: luxpay-eval-scope.xlsx (completed by Aditya, please review and update the data inventory section)
- Drive: kickoff materials and scoring harness (link above)
- HubSpot: LUX-2387 updated with the timeline and credits

Owners and owners’ first deliverables: 
- Aditya Rao (Redwood AE) — send calendar + invite, coordinate readout logistics (by 2027-05-03)
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood SE) — deliver scoring harness and initial baseline run (by 2027-05-07)
- Monica Patel (Redwood CS Ops) — dashboard metrics template & access for LuxPay (by 2027-05-07)
- Elena Rossi (LuxPay) — provision S3 bucket & IAM role (by 2027-05-03)
- Marcus Leong (LuxPay) — confirm network access & test environment (by 2027-05-03)

Weekly cadence: 30 minutes, Thursdays 11:00 AM ET (starting Thu 2027-05-13) — light status, blockers, quick demos.

Security docs: attached SOC2 summary and data retention statement. If you need the full report we’ll route the NDA channel.

Next: I’ll send the calendar invite and demo account keys (read-only) once Marcus confirms the S3 role.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this running.

Best,
Aditya Rao | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123
